$comment: The shape registry. Icons: the custom outlines of sgs/icon (icon plan D2, Phase D), read through includes/helpers-icon.php::sgs_icon_outline_shapes() and src/utils/icon-shapes.js (OUTLINE_SHAPES), which keep only entries whose `surfaces` include `icons`. Media: the Shape grid of every media slot (Spec 49 7.5), read through includes/media/atoms/shape.php::sgs_media_atom_shape_registry() and src/utils/icon-shapes.js (MEDIA_SHAPES), which keep only entries whose `surfaces` include `media`. Per entry: slug, label, d (one closed path in a 0 0 100 100 box that touches the box's edges; radius entries have none), proportions (`stretch` fills the box, `keep` fits the shape inside it; the default when a slot stores none), paint (`radius`: border-radius on the surface, `mask`: a mask on the mask layer), ratio (the Ratio written when the shape is picked and no Ratio is set; '' writes none) and surfaces. The box shapes of the icon (square, circle, pill) are drawn by icon/style.css. The star points up, fills the box's width and is drawn about the box's centre (its circumcentre, 50 50), so its top point touches the top edge and its lower points stop short of the bottom; its inner radius is 0.55 of its outer radius, which keeps a centred glyph up to 31.5% of the shape's size inside its inner pentagon (icon/style.css gives the star a default size of 3.2 times the icon for that reason). The icon's render.php draws the path behind the glyph with its stroke inside the path (twice the border width, clipped to the path), so a path may run to the viewBox edge.
